title: Heisenberg's uranium program as decoy for a secret electromagnetic isotope separation program

tellings.quote: And basically the the picture that emerges is this that the pro the uranium enrichment program that um Heisenberg was running was a red herring

plain: The claim is that Nazi Germany's uranium enrichment program, run by the scientist Werner Heisenberg in the 1940s, was a red herring meant to draw attention away from a secret program that separated uranium by electromagnetic means. The researcher Jason Jorjani lays this out as the picture that "emerges," drawing on the writer Plimpton Hydrick's book Critical Mass and on a writer named Farrell. If true, Germany's real atomic work was hidden behind the program everyone was watching.
